p: lodging place: Meaning, the place where they would camp.
children ask their fathers in time: God commands that not only we ourselves profit by this wonderful work, but that our posterity may know the cause of it, and glorify his Name.
twelve stones in the midst of: Besides the twelve stones that were carried by the tribes and set up in Gilgal.
in the presence of the people: Meaning, in the presence or sight of the people.
LORD unto battle: That is, before the Ark.
ark of the testimony: Because the ark testified God's presence, and the tables of the Law contained in it signified God's will toward his people.
first month: Called Abib or Nisan, containing part of March and part of April.
earth might know the hand of: God's benefits serve as a further condemnation to the wicked, and stir up his own to reverence and obey him.
